_comment: Credential-custody mode: the agent holds a placeholder, never a secret.
Secrets are read here (env or file:/path with 0600 + owner check) and kept
inside the gateway/proxy. Hand the agent only policy.agent_environment():
a map of secret_name to an opaque placeholder it may place in a request.
The proxy swaps the placeholder for the real value only for a host in that
credential's allowed_hosts. A placeholder used elsewhere is refused.
_note_enforce_policy: Defaults to false: the gateway only injects credentials. Enforcement is
the wrapped tool's job. Set true ONLY if your tools are not wrapped yet.
